# Rights

Named rights: each one is stated once, and every lifecycle that uses it says in which of its states it holds.

## SecretOnlyOwner

Only its owner may change a secret item.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Name | `SecretOnlyOwner` |
| Allows or denies | denies |
| Who | everyone |
| Except | [DocumentOwner](actors/document-owner.md) |
| Does | `modify`, `delete`, `change-owner` |
| When | `subject.classification = 'secret'` |
| Used by | [DocumentLifecycle](processes/document-lifecycle.md) (all states) |
